# Enhance

Turn your 3D project scope into a photorealistic design in one click.

July 24, 2026

Table of contents

[Overview](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/15193307-enhance#h_53ce71f40d)[How to use Enhance](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/15193307-enhance#h_dd408ab5f6)[Why this is better](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/15193307-enhance#h_ecb603e9da)

**What's new?** Enhance uses AI to **turn your 3D model into photorealistic designs you can use to impress homeowners to close the deal.** Pick your angles, hit Enhance, and get back a gallery of finished visualizations — no design software, no extra steps.

To view ongoing updates to the Enhance feature, [visit this article](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/16074716-how-do-i-create-photorealistic-images-of-3d-models).

# Overview

When you're at the kitchen table trying to close a job, a photorealistic image of the finished home is what makes homeowners say yes. Enhance takes the exterior design you've already built in Hover 3D and generates polished, photo-quality visualizations directly from it. Capture the angles that sell the project, let Hover's AI do the work, and share images that look like professional architectural renderings.

* * *

# How to use Enhance

Use Enhance to generate photorealistic designs from any angle of your 3D design.

- From the Project Details Page, navigate to the 3D workspace - select **Start designing in 3D**

- Scope your project as usual by applying materials, colors, and more to the model

- Select **Enhance** from the action bar at the bottom of the screen





  - You will be prompted to click or tap **Save and continue**, and name your design


![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/2407091202/c1d9ee0626aeadfd51afb14d05b9/Enhance+button+to+click.png?expires=1794262500&signature=4687a9657203ed4cfb06d884df79817f0023167d56103923f069284ed599b4e1&req=diQnEcl3nINfW%2FMW1HO4zZiIztANC1IVs02PpIruJKKCYLxwLfENCyF5TTRB%0Ac3MS2W4C7bF%2BWU1%2B5Qs%3D%0A)

- Position the 3D model to the angle you want, then click or tap **Enhance this angle**.





  - Repeat for any additional angles you want to generate


![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/2407154962/098daf8db792b9dc221b04d71266/Screenshot+2026-05-20+at+3_18_21%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1794262500&signature=864c7122ef583852be3c73ed336929549819aa63439240f40180f0f37112b05f&req=diQnEch7mYhZW%2FMW1HO4zRaFAiEkLq41IL4jX2Jl95UD7YWV%2BPylBJVhWVWa%0AXRjmvHVqOnQ5zmblRvQ%3D%0A)

- Wait for Hover's AI to process your images. This usually takes a few seconds but can take up to a few minutes

- When your images are ready, click or tap **View photos** to open the gallery

- Select individual images to download, or choose **Download all** to save the full set.


![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/2407163748/a524baabce76616d75c65a7a12c5/Gemini_Generated_Image_357ufg357ufg357u.png?expires=1794262500&signature=10a3bbfaa9d660e0ca0c85c37d7c2574486c36087324476756005a4d97763163&req=diQnEch4noZbUfMW1HO4zWm3yxtybLtRq8o9EZKwrPDsrqY5pi3mHPSwpm8k%0AWQ9AaYlA1XXHx85JCJg%3D%0A)

**Pro Tip:** Enhance multiple angles — front, side, and any detail views — before you sit down with the homeowner. You'll have a full set of visualizations ready to share without stepping away from the conversation.

* * *

# Why this is better

Before the capabilities of Enhance, the 3D model gave homeowners a clear picture of the scope, but it didn't always carry the emotional weight needed to close. Getting to a fully polished visual meant extra tools, extra time, or settling for a screenshot.

- **Photorealistic results, no additional handoff required.** Hover's AI generates professional-quality visualizations directly from your existing 3D design.

- **Everything stays inside Hover.** No exporting, no third-party software, no extra steps between scoping the project and presenting it.

- **Multiple angles in one session.** Generate every view you need to sell the project and download a full set of images to share with the homeowner so they can see the whole picture.

- **Shorter path to yes.** Homeowners can see exactly what their finished home will look like before work begins, which reduces hesitation and moves the conversation forward.
